title: Higher Ground
teaches: the Hohmann transfer — two burns, half an orbit apart
brief:
Moving between two circular orbits takes exactly two burns.

The first raises your apoapsis to the height you want. Then you coast half an orbit, doing nothing, all the way up to that apoapsis. The second burn, there, raises the other side to match.

You are in a 150 km circular orbit. Be in a 500 km circular one, eccentricity under 0.02, and hold it for half a minute.

It is the cheapest way to move between two orbits, and the slowest. Both of those facts are on the scoreboard.
hints: Burn prograde until APO reads 500 km. Then stop — really stop.
WAIT UNTIL TAPO < 10 will take you to the top of the transfer.
The second burn is prograde again, and raises PERI to meet APO.

reference.solution:
; Higher Ground — raise apoapsis, coast to it, raise periapsis to match.
        ORIENT  PROGRADE
        THROTTLE 1
        BURN    UNTIL APO > 500000
        THROTTLE 0
        WAIT    UNTIL TAPO < 8
        THROTTLE 0.5
        BURN    UNTIL PERI > 498000
        HALT
